build_feature_extractor: build a FeatureExtractor instance that loads a Detectron model and extracts visual features from images
run_extract_features: run the extract_features method to process an imdb_gt file and save extracted features as numpy files
test_get_detectron_features: test the get_detectron_features method with a list of image paths to return feature tensors and info dicts
refactor__image_transform: refactor the _image_transform method to handle grayscale images and resize them for detection model input
review__process_feature_extraction: review the _process_feature_extraction method that applies NMS and extracts per-box features from detection output
